mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a year-over-year decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate over the prior 3 months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a declining unemployment rate signals aggressive monetary tightening amid strong labor conditions, suppressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-inflation peak regimes, a year-over-year decline in CPI below 3.0% signals easing inflation pressures that reduce the risk of prolonged monetary tightening, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-inflation peak periods when CPIAUCSL declines below 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
